verdicts.reason: I picked B because it actually rearranges the layout for the banner shape. The headline sits as a two-line block on the left and the CTA pill is on the right, so it reads left to right with bigger, more readable type. Its flaws are tight margins (the CTA nearly touches the right edge) and an awkward 'and / a little sunshine.' line break. A just shrinks the original's centred stack into the strip. Its one-line headline is tiny and crammed against the top edge, and the CTA pill and its label are too small to read. The vertical stack wastes the width of the banner.
